metadata.description: Local time (SE Asia Standard Time). Set to DailyRoutineStartDate 21:00 (FSD 16.2)

properties.description: Generic dataset (SQL Server connector, linked service Agus_SqlServer_dwh) for Lookup and Copy activities that call schema ret procedures (no table bound).
One Parquet file per table and business date: <container>/<BlobPath>/year=YYYY/month=MM/day=DD/<schema>_<table>_<yyyyMMdd>_<RunId>.parquet (FR-007, MD-07, DEC-04).
Archive folder (binary) for Get Metadata (child items) and Delete activities (FR-013, FR-018).

FSD 4.18 / 5.4 / 6.1: remove exactly the archive files that this table log wrote, as listed by ret.usp_GetRunArchiveFiles (layout MD-07, no RunId in the file name), then record the result with ret.usp_LogCleanupResult (success: dates marked REMOVED; failure: orphan-file flag, ERR-EXP-03).

activities.name: LKP_GetRunArchiveFiles
activities.description: FSD 4.18: files this table log may have written (ExportStatus SUCCEEDED, FAILED or STOPPED).

activities.name: FE_DeleteRunFiles
activities.description: One file per business date; a missing folder means the file was never written.

ifTrueActivities.name: DEL_RunFile
ifTrueActivities.description: Deletes exactly one file of this run: <FolderPath>/<FileName> from ret.RetentionArchiveDate (no pattern; files of other runs are never touched).

value.value: @concat('One or more archive files of this run could not be deleted (', pipeline().parameters.BlobPath, '). ADF run ', pipeline().RunId)

properties.description: FR-006 / FR-007 / FR-019 (IC-02, DR-02, RB-06): export every PENDING business date of a table log to Parquet, one Copy activity per date, sequential (DEC-07), each result recorded with ret.usp_LogExportResult.

activities.name: LKP_CheckExecutionWindow
activities.description: FR-019: IC window 21:00-05:00 UTC+7 before the first export (always 1 for the Daily Routine).

ErrorMessage.value: Initial Cut-off window end reached before the export started (FR-019).

activities.name: UNT_ExportBusinessDates
activities.description: One iteration per business date still PENDING (usp_GetExportPlan with MaxRows = 1). Stops when ContinueExport = 0, no date remains, or an error occurs.

ifTrueActivities.name: CPY_ExportBusinessDate
ifTrueActivities.description: IC-02 / DR-02: rows of one business date -> one Parquet file. Source ret.usp_ExportSourceRows (all columns, ordinal order, no transformation). File name carries the RunId (DBR-07).

ifTrueActivities.name: LKP_LogExport_Succeeded
ifTrueActivities.description: Records the Copy result; in an IC also checks the window (ERR-WIN-01). Returns ContinueExport, CleanupRequired, RemainingDates.

ifTrueActivities.name: LKP_LogExport_Failed
ifTrueActivities.description: ERR-EXP-01: export failed after retries; loop stops, cleanup required.

ifTrueActivities.name: SET_Continue_LogError
ifTrueActivities.description: Fail-safe: result of a written file could not be recorded; stop and remove this run's files.

activities.name: IF_CleanupOnStop
activities.description: Batch-delete path: remove this run's files on export failure or window stop (E2). Rebuild path passes CleanupOnStop = false: usp_TableRebuildAbort runs first (SQL contract).

properties.description: PRC-02 batch-delete path (IC-01..IC-04a) and PRC-03 (DR-02..DR-04): export -> validate -> batch delete -> post-check; this run's files are removed when validation fails (FR-018).

activities.name: IF_ExportRequired
activities.description: NextAction VALIDATE (IC, expired rows only, DBR-03) skips the export.

activities.name: LKP_ValidateArchive
activities.description: IC-03 / DR-03 / FR-008 (BR-08 gate): per-date and total row counts. Always called after the export step; a failed or stopped export makes it return FAILED, so nothing is removed.

ifTrueActivities.name: LKP_BatchDelete
ifTrueActivities.description: IC-04a / DR-04 / FR-009: recount (DBR-06), DELETE TOP (BatchSize) + pause, window stop in IC.

ifTrueActivities.name: SET_Cleanup_FromDelete
ifTrueActivities.description: CleanupRequired = 1 only for ERR-VAL-02 (recount differs, nothing deleted).

ifTrueActivities.name: LKP_PostCheck
ifTrueActivities.description: FR-020 / AC-03 / AC-07: no rows before the DWH cut-off; IC: retained rows not reduced, status COMPLETED.

activities.name: IF_CleanupRequired
activities.description: E3: validation failure or ERR-VAL-02 -> remove this run's files; nothing removed from the DWH.

activities.name: EXEC_FileCleanup_OnValidationError
activities.description: Validation could not be executed: remove this run's files (fail-safe, BR-08).

properties.description: FR-010 / Section 8.4 table rebuild (Initial Cut-off Run, method TABLE_REBUILD, downtime reference required): Prepare (RB-01..05) -> export from original (RB-06) -> validate (RB-07) -> Swap (RB-07..10) -> post-check; Abort + file cleanup on any failure before the swap commits.

activities.name: LKP_RebuildPrepare
activities.description: RB-01..RB-05 (MD-04 steps 1-2): checks, new table <table>__RBD_<RunId> with the retained rows, keys/constraints/indexes, count check. Original table unchanged.

activities.name: IF_ExportRequired
activities.description: RB-06 (MD-04 step 3): archived segment exported from the ORIGINAL table.

ifTrueActivities.name: LKP_RebuildSwap
ifTrueActivities.description: RB-07 recount, RB-08 truncate + drop + rename in one transaction (MD-04 steps 4-5, MD-06, DEC-13), RB-09 reseed / view refresh, RB-10 definition check.

ifTrueActivities.name: LKP_RebuildAbort
ifTrueActivities.description: Any failure before RB-08 commits: drop the new table, revoke validation, request file cleanup.

properties.description: FR-017 / PRC-05: resume validated batch-delete ranges of earlier runs, oldest first, until none is pending. A non-COMPLETED result stops the loop; the table log status set by ret.usp_BatchDelete then blocks further steps.

activities.name: LKP_BatchDelete_Resume
activities.description: Removes the remaining rows of a validated range of an earlier run without export (DBR-09).

activities.name: IF_UnexpectedError

message.value: @concat('Resume of a validated range failed: ', variables('vUnexpectedError'))

activities.description: Only an ADF/connection error fails the pipeline; FAILED/STOPPED results are already recorded by the procedure.

properties.description: Per-table data steps after usp_BeginTable returned PROCEED: resume -> identify eligible data -> batch-delete path or table-rebuild path (IC only) -> post-check.

activities.name: IF_PendingResume
activities.description: FR-017: resume pending ranges before new data is identified.

activities.name: LKP_IdentifyEligibleData
activities.description: IC-01 / DR-01 / FR-005 (FR-023 for child tables): per business-date snapshot; NextAction EXPORT / VALIDATE / NONE.

activities.name: SW_ProcessingPath
activities.description: BATCH: Daily Routine or IC with BATCH_DELETE. REBUILD: IC with TABLE_REBUILD (BR-11). IC_NODATA: IC without eligible rows - post-check only, so the table reaches COMPLETED. NONE: nothing eligible (DR) or the step before failed (status already recorded).

properties.description: FSD 4.13 / 5.4 one level (YEAR or FILE): list the items, let ret.usp_GetExpiredArchiveFolders decide, delete the expired year folders of this table or the expired files, record the result (ERR-ARC-01 on failure; the next Daily Routine completes).

activities.name: GMD_ListChildItems
activities.description: YEAR: container root (year folders). FILE: folder <cut-off year>/<BlobPath>. 'exists' keeps a missing folder from failing the activity.

activities.name: LKP_GetExpiredArchiveFolders
activities.description: Names and dates parsed in SQL; returns DELETE rows only (YEAR: <yyyy>/<BlobPath> before the cut-off year; FILE: files dated before the archive cut-off). Non-matching names are never deleted.

activities.name: FE_DeleteExpiredItems
activities.description: Parallel, batch 4 (FSD 6.1). The year folder is shared by all tables, so the table folder may not exist.

ifTrueActivities.name: DEL_ExpiredItem
ifTrueActivities.description: YEAR: whole folder <yyyy>/<BlobPath> (recursive). FILE: one file <BlobPath>_<yyyyMMdd>.parquet.

value.value: @concat('ERR-ARC-01: one or more expired items could not be deleted at level ', pipeline().parameters.Level, ' of ', if(empty(pipeline().parameters.FolderPath), '<container root>', pipeline().parameters.FolderPath), '. ADF run ', pipeline().RunId)

properties.description: FSD 4.13 / 5.4 / DR-05: delete archive data with business date before the archive cut-off, layout MD-07 <container>/<yyyy>/<BlobPath>/<BlobPath>_<yyyyMMdd>.parquet: level YEAR on the container root, then level FILE in the cut-off year. A missing folder is a no-op.

activities.name: EXEC_Level_Year
activities.description: Container root: folders <yyyy>/<BlobPath> of years before the archive cut-off year are deleted whole.

activities.name: EXEC_Level_File
activities.description: Folder <archive cut-off year>/<BlobPath>: files dated before the archive cut-off are deleted.

properties.description: PL-03 per table (IC-01..IC-05, DR-01..DR-06): usp_BeginTable -> data steps (PL_RET_03A) -> expired archive deletion (PL-04, Daily Routine) -> usp_EndTable (always).

activities.name: LKP_BeginTable
activities.description: FR-002 / FR-016 / FR-017 / FR-023: table log, lock, checks V-01..V-11, gates DBR-18/DBR-19, pending resume. BeginResult PROCEED / SKIPPED / FAILED; CanRunArchiveExpiry.

activities.name: IF_Proceed
activities.description: Dry validation (PL_RET_01 with ValidateOnly = true, process type VALIDATION, decision D-3) stops after the checks of usp_BeginTable; nothing is exported or deleted.

activities.name: IF_ArchiveExpiry
activities.description: DR-05 runs whenever V-05 and V-06 passed, whatever happened earlier (BR-14, PRC-03 E1-E4), also when the header table was skipped by DBR-19.

activities.name: LKP_EndTable
activities.description: IC-05 / DR-06 / FR-014: always called; final status, IC status on failure/stop, lock release. An ADF-level error message (if any) is passed as @ErrorMessage, otherwise NULL.

activities.name: IF_TableFailed

message.value: @concat(pipeline().parameters.SchemaName, '.', pipeline().parameters.TableName, ' ended ', activity('LKP_EndTable').output.firstRow.FinalStatus, ' (', string(coalesce(activity('LKP_EndTable').output.firstRow?.ErrorCode, 'no code')), '). See ret.RetentionTableLog TableLogId ', string(activity('LKP_BeginTable').output.firstRow.TableLogId), '.')

activities.description: Makes a failed table visible in ADF monitoring; the master continues with the next table.

properties.description: PL-01 / PRC-02 / FR-011: Initial Cut-off Run, triggered manually inside 21:00-05:00 UTC+7 (BR-17). TableConfigIdList EMPTY = automatic mode (CR-01, SQL v0.5): all active tables not yet COMPLETED, SMALL/MEDIUM before LARGE, child tables first; run again until every table is COMPLETED. TableConfigIdList given = explicit ordered list. LARGE or TABLE_REBUILD tables require DowntimeReference (BR-16, D-07). Concurrency 1. ValidateOnly = true: dry validation (process type VALIDATION, decision D-3, FSD 4.2 / 4.11): checks V-01..V-11 only, nothing exported or deleted, DowntimeReference ignored; empty TableConfigIdList = all active tables not COMPLETED.

activities.name: LKP_StartRun

sqlReaderQuery.value: @concat('EXEC ret.usp_StartRun @ProcessType = ''', if(bool(pipeline().parameters.ValidateOnly), 'VALIDATION', 'INITIAL_CUTOFF'), ''', @TriggerType = ''', if(equals(pipeline().TriggerType, 'ScheduleTrigger'), 'SCHEDULE', 'MANUAL'), ''', @AdfPipelineRunId = ''', pipeline().RunId, ''', @RunDate = ', if(empty(trim(pipeline().parameters.RunDate)), 'NULL', concat('''', formatDateTime(if(empty(trim(pipeline().parameters.RunDate)), '1900-01-01', trim(pipeline().parameters.RunDate)), 'yyyy-MM-dd'), '''')), ', @TriggeredBy = ', concat('N''', replace(if(empty(trim(pipeline().parameters.TriggeredBy)), concat(pipeline().TriggerType, ': ', pipeline().TriggerName), trim(pipeline().parameters.TriggeredBy)), '''', ''''''), ''''), ', @DowntimeReference = ', if(bool(pipeline().parameters.ValidateOnly), 'NULL', if(empty(trim(pipeline().parameters.DowntimeReference)), 'NULL', concat('N''', replace(trim(pipeline().parameters.DowntimeReference), '''', ''''''), ''''))), ';')

activities.description: FR-003 / FR-014: run record, run date fixed in UTC+7 (override may only be earlier, DBR-15); idempotent per ADF pipeline run ID. Optional values are passed as NULL when empty.

activities.name: SET_ProcessType
activities.description: Process type as recorded by usp_StartRun (VALIDATION when ValidateOnly = true).

activities.name: LKP_GetTablesToProcess
activities.description: FR-004: table selection per process type; ordered by ProcessingOrder (child tables first, DBR-19 / DBR-18).

activities.name: FE_Tables
activities.description: Sequential (DEC-07). A failed table never blocks the next one.

activities.name: LKP_EndRun
activities.description: FR-014: closes the run; raises an error (pipeline FAILED) when the run is not SUCCEEDED [REC 8.3].

sqlReaderQuery.value: @concat('EXEC ret.usp_EndRun @RunId = ', variables('vRunId'), ', @ErrorMessage = ', concat('N''', replace(concat('Table selection failed: ', activity('LKP_GetTablesToProcess').error.message), '''', ''''''), ''''), ', @FailPipelineOnError = 1;')

properties.description: PL-02 / PRC-03 / FR-012: Daily Routine, scheduled every day 21:00 UTC+7 (BR-18). Selects active tables whose Initial Cut-off Run completed before the run date, from DailyRoutineStartDate (FR-020). RunDate empty = today UTC+7; manual rerun may pass an earlier date (DBR-15). Concurrency 1.

activities.name: LKP_StartRun

sqlReaderQuery.value: @concat('EXEC ret.usp_StartRun @ProcessType = ''', 'DAILY_ROUTINE', ''', @TriggerType = ''', if(equals(pipeline().TriggerType, 'ScheduleTrigger'), 'SCHEDULE', 'MANUAL'), ''', @AdfPipelineRunId = ''', pipeline().RunId, ''', @RunDate = ', if(empty(trim(pipeline().parameters.RunDate)), 'NULL', concat('''', formatDateTime(if(empty(trim(pipeline().parameters.RunDate)), '1900-01-01', trim(pipeline().parameters.RunDate)), 'yyyy-MM-dd'), '''')), ', @TriggeredBy = ', concat('N''', replace(if(empty(trim(pipeline().parameters.TriggeredBy)), concat(pipeline().TriggerType, ': ', pipeline().TriggerName), trim(pipeline().parameters.TriggeredBy)), '''', ''''''), ''''), ', @DowntimeReference = ', 'NULL', ';')

activities.description: FR-003 / FR-014: run record, run date fixed in UTC+7 (override may only be earlier, DBR-15); idempotent per ADF pipeline run ID. Optional values are passed as NULL when empty.

activities.name: SET_ProcessType
activities.description: Process type as recorded by usp_StartRun (VALIDATION when ValidateOnly = true).

activities.name: LKP_GetTablesToProcess
activities.description: FR-004: table selection per process type; ordered by ProcessingOrder (child tables first, DBR-19 / DBR-18).

activities.name: FE_Tables
activities.description: Sequential (DEC-07). A failed table never blocks the next one.

activities.name: LKP_EndRun
activities.description: FR-014: closes the run; raises an error (pipeline FAILED) when the run is not SUCCEEDED [REC 8.3].

sqlReaderQuery.value: @concat('EXEC ret.usp_EndRun @RunId = ', variables('vRunId'), ', @ErrorMessage = ', concat('N''', replace(concat('Table selection failed: ', activity('LKP_GetTablesToProcess').error.message), '''', ''''''), ''''), ', @FailPipelineOnError = 1;')

properties.description: BR-18: Daily Routine every day at 21:00 UTC+7 (SE Asia Standard Time). Deployed STOPPED: start it only after ret.usp_ActivateDailyRoutine (FSD 16.2, FR-020).
